messages:
sam: noticing a surge of preemptions in eu-west around 11:20 UTC, looks tied to ephemeral pool churn. Seeing tail-latency spikes for small tenants. anyone else?
infra-bot: Deploy event detected: autoscaler/ephemeral-reaper v2.4 rolled at 11:19:57 UTC. Reaper triggered 42 preempts in 3m. Logs: `reaper:evict(reason=ephemeral_idle, count=42)`
ada: ugh, that reaper config is pretty aggressive for short-lived bursts. current preempt window is 30s, noise_floor is 0.12 (percent). small tenants with intermittent traffic are getting bounced.
michael: what's the impact on SLOs / customer tickets? if we relax preempt window we might increase tail cost (more warm slots kept). need numbers to tradeoff SLA credits vs infra $.
liz: can we try a staged change? proposal: bump preempt_window -> 90s for ephemeral pools in eu-west, raise noise_floor -> 0.5, and add a cooldown per-tenant of 3m so we don't oscillate. rollout as a canary to 10% of hosts for 30m.
sam: sounds reasonable. quick sim: with 90s we reduce preempts by ~60% in the trace I pulled, warm-slot overhead roughly +6% tokens served on idle slots (cost ~ +$0.04/hr per host). margin seems ok for now.
ada: config snippet (can apply via `infractl`):
```
ephemeral_reaper:
  preempt_window_seconds: 90
  noise_floor_fraction: 0.5
  per_tenant_cooldown_seconds: 180
  canary_fraction: 0.10
```
liz: thanks. i'll prepare canary pipeline and a Prometheus dashboard patch for preempt_count, tenant_restarts, warm_slot_util, and tail_p95 latency.
michael: need cost estimate and rollback plan before broader rollout. also propose we tie tenant-level credits: any tenant that experienced >5 preempts in the 30m window gets an SLA ticket auto-created for review (not necessarily $$ credit, just review).
oncall-aaron: oncall FYI — will monitor infra-alerts. if tail_p95 jumps >20% during canary, i'll cut traffic to canary and roll back. also set alert: `preempt_rate > 10/min` for eu-west ephemeral pool.
sam: rolling the canary now to 10% hosts in eu-west. ping here with dashboard link when ready so we can watch live. :rocket:
infra-bot: Canary rollout started: ephemeral-reaper config applied to 10% hosts in eu-west at 11:35:02 UTC. Monitoring window 30m.
ada: nice. if canary looks good, next step is 50% for 60m then metric-check gate to 100%.
michael: once canary completes, i'll run cost calc and prepare a short note for product about potential billing/credit policy (we should avoid ad-hoc credits).
sam: update 11:48 — initial 10m of canary looks promising: preempts down 55%, tail_p95 down 18% for affected tenants, warm-slot utilization up 3%. continuing to monitor.
oncall-aaron: seeing one tenant with repeated restarts (tenant-42) — tagging @ada to investigate if it's application-level or infra oscillation.
ada: looking — tenant-42 shows app restarts correlated with container restarts, not infra preempt. opening ticket.
liz: great. will keep dashboard link in the thread. once we hit 50% and run full checks, i'll post results here.
